examples.text: Had I known the tour would be so bad, I wouldn't have booked it. (France; C1 EFFECTIVE OPERATIONAL PROFICIENCY; 1998; French; Pass)

Sometimes I think that had I gone to Britain without this experience, my life would have been different. (Czech Republic; C1 EFFECTIVE OPERATIONAL PROFICIENCY; 2006; Czech; Pass)
Thus, you have not fulfilled your task with due care, as you have stated in your letter. (Austria; C1 EFFECTIVE OPERATIONAL PROFICIENCY; 2008; German; Pass)
